    - name: domain
      directories:
        - src/domain/**
      roles:
        - entity

    - name: application
      directories:
        - src/application/**

        - dto
        - application-service
        - repository-interface
        - validation

      directories:
        - src/common/**
      roles:
        - helper
        - adapter
    - name: presentation
      directories:
        - src/presentation/**
      roles:
        - controller
        - middleware
        - response
    - name: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/infrastructure/**
      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - orm-entity
        - framework-setup
    - name: main
      directories:
        - src/main/**
      roles:
        - factory
default_exclude_paths:
  - "node_modules/**"
  - "dist/**"
  - "**/*.spec.ts"
  - "**/*.test.ts"
